title: 目標達成の後に・みんなのちゃんこ鍋☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono hosts the Chanko Tournament to bond with her fans, and participants come from all over to show off their own signature chanko!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Chanko Tournament ends on a warm note with Hishi Akebono saying how tasty everyone's chanko looks despite them all being different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, Hishi Akebono posts some words she lives by on Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In her post, she urges everyone to protect and preserve their own unique flavors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters S. is waiting for us once summer camp is over. It's time to ramp up training so we can be at our best for it!
